question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

In all cases, they __bestow__ credits on manufacturers that exceed the standards.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bestow"** means to confer or present (an honor, right, or gift). (प्रदान करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The committee will** bestow** the award upon the most deserving candidate.
 
 
 
• **"Preserve"** refers to maintaining something in its original or existing state. (संरक्षित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Efforts are being made to **preserve** the ancient manuscripts.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'bestow'** is **'preserve'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confer** (प्रदान करना): To grant or bestow (a title, degree, benefit, or right).

 
 
• **Example:** The university will confer honorary degrees on several distinguished guests.
 
 
 
• **Award** (पुरस्कार देना): To give or order the giving of something as an official payment, compensation, or prize.
 
 
• **Example:** She was awarded the Nobel Prize for her contributions to physics.
 
 
 
• **Grant** (अनुदान देना): To agree to give or allow (something requested) to.
 
 
• **Example:** The council has granted permission for the new building project.
